row: Dr. Judy Morgan’s Naturally Healthy Pets

Dr. Judy Morgan has over 39 years experience as an integrative veterinarian, acupuncturist, chiropractor, food therapist, author, and speaker. Dr. Morgan owned and operated two veterinary hospitals that offer an integrative approach combining holistic medicine with traditional western techniques. Her goal is to change the lives of over 10 million pets by educating and empowering pet owners worldwide in the use of natural healing therapies, and minimizing the use of chemicals, vaccinations, and poor quality processed food.

Your Pet's Advocate,
JUDY MORGAN DVM, CVA, CVCP, CVFT
Best-selling Author of Five Books
2024 IAOTP Top Holistic Veterinarian of the Decade
2023 Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America
2023 People's Choice Award Winner
2022 Game Changer Award Winner
2021 IAOTP Empowered Woman of the Year
2019 Pet Age Woman of Influence
2019 IAOTP Veterinarian of the Year
2019 Veterinarian Hero Award Nominee
2018 Woman of the Year in the Pet Industry
